title: Nearby Matches in Real Time
prompt: Bumble wants to add a feature where users see potential matches nearby in real time as they move around a city. Design the backend for this.
key_points: Asks clarifying questions first (number of users, how fresh locations must be, privacy)
Efficient location storage and search (geohashing or a geospatial index)
Handles constant location updates without overloading the database (caching, batching)
Filters out users already swiped on or blocked
Discusses tradeoffs: freshness vs battery life and cost
follow_ups: What happens at a concert with 50,000 users in one spot?
How would you keep this working if one region's servers go down?
